question: Under what temporal condition of practice is old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: The practice is carried out for one year.
When that practice has been performed, a condition arises.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The specific practice referred to is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
